intro: A broken garage door spring stops your day. Your door might not open. It could feel extremely heavy. Or it might lift a few inches then stop. This is a common issue for many homes in Cicero. We provide immediate garage door spring repair. Our technicians replace broken torsion and extension springs. We ensure your garage door operates safely again. We are a family-owned business. We provide upfront, flat-rate quotes before any work starts. Book online and receive a 10% discount on your spring repair service. Our trucks carry common parts. We are ready to work when we arrive.
localContext: Cicero's dense blocks of brick bungalows and two-flats often feature detached single-car garages. These sit on shared alleys. Many of these garages still use hardware decades old. Daily use and Chicagoland's cold winters stress garage door springs. Over time, these springs weaken and break. A broken spring can pin a car inside a single-car garage with tight alley clearances. An alley-facing garage stuck open presents a real security concern. Residents in Boulevard Manor, Grant Works, and Clyde face these issues regularly. We understand the specific challenges of Cicero’s garage door systems. We replace worn-out springs with new, high-cycle parts built for lasting performance.

problemSigns.sign: Door won't lift or feels extremely heavy
problemSigns.detail: The spring provides the lift. Without it, the door's full weight is unsupported.

problemSigns.sign: Visible gap in the torsion spring above the door
problemSigns.detail: A clear break in the coiled metal indicates a broken spring.

problemSigns.sign: Door lifts a few inches then stops
problemSigns.detail: The opener struggles without spring assistance, then reverses for safety.
Broken springs relieve tension, causing the lift cables to go slack.
